title: SOLID BIOMECHANICS
description: The structure, function, and mechanical properties of various tissues in biolgical systems, such as blood vessels, muscle, skin, brain tissue, bone, tendon, cartilage, ligaments, etc. are examined. The establishment of basic governing mechanical principles and constitutive relations for each tissue. Experimental determination of various tissue properties. Medical and clinical implications of tissue mechanical behavior
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ENME E3105 ) and ( ENME E3113 ) and ENME E3105 AND ENME E3113 Applications of continuum mechanics to the understanding of various biological tissues properties.
